instruction.text: The school has opened a new book club and is keeping track of how many pupils attend. Decide if the following statements about the time graph are true.

atoms.a: This time graph shows how many books each child in the school read each week.
This time graph shows how many pupils attended the book club each week.
How many pupils attended the book club in week 6?
How many more pupils attended the book club in week 7 than in week 1?
atoms.hint: To figure out the difference between two weeks you can subtract the number of attending pupils on the later date from the number of pupils on the earlier date.

atoms.a: In how many weeks did more than 12 pupils attend the book club?
How many weeks are shown on this time graph?
In which week did 18 pupils attend the book club?
